So `vips_thumbnail_image` calls `vips_colourspace(in, &t[2], interpretation, NULL)` where `interpretation` is the processing color space (typically sRGB). If the input image has `Type = VIPS_INTERPRETATION_CMC = 18`, then `vips_colourspace` will look up the conversion path from CMC to sRGB, which includes `vips_CMC2LCh`.

Let me check the colourspace.c to see how the conversion path is determined:
